race.comment: Tough with most on debut. FINARDI (3) is a colt by Nicconi on debut for the Hayes yard. He looked good winning a recent jumpout and looks ready to run a big race, should take some beating. ISN'T SHE GORGEOUS (9) is a filly by Zoustar on debut for the Lloyd Kennewell yard. She's jumped out fairly but gets every hope from the gate and the stable are typically good with the juveniles. HANK HONK (4) is a Hanseatic gelding on debut for the Lindsay Smith yard. He's won a couple of jumpouts and should take some beating on the home track. ON HER OWN (11) daughter of Palace Pier out of Aonair who was purchased for AUD $ 55,000 (Inglis 2025 Classic Yearling Sale). Going well leading into this, placing in most recently in a jump-out at Burrumbeet. Worth consideration.
